title: Cyberpunk Punk Girl
description: A young woman with a tall, spiky pink mohawk stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She wears a cropped denim vest, black shorts with fishnet stockings, and heavy boots while holding a steampunk-style ray gun emitting purple energy in her right hand and casting a purple energy effect with her left.
prompt: A fierce young woman with a massive spiky pink mohawk and shaved sides, pale skin with tattoos, wearing a cropped copper top under a torn denim vest, black shorts with fishnet stockings and chains, fingerless gloves, and chunky boots. She is in an action stance holding a brass and copper steampunk ray gun that emits swirling purple plasma, while her other hand crackles with purple energy. Dramatic anime-influenced digital art style, clean lines, solid gray background.
